attacks.name: Dizzying Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Toxbreeze
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh3-3.flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

attacks.name: Mushroom Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

swsh3-4.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

swsh3-5.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

swsh3-6.flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

swsh3-7.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

swsh3-8.flavorText: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

swsh3-9.flavorText: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

swsh3-10.flavorText: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

attacks.name: Wind Shard
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.text: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

swsh3-11.flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

swsh3-12.flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

attacks.name: Splitting Arrow
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Deep Forest Camo
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon-GX.

swsh3-13.flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-14.flavorText: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

attacks.name: Captivate
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

swsh3-15.flavorText: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

attacks.name: Power Whip
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Time Out Kick
attacks.text: You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

swsh3-16.flavorText: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

attacks.name: Gnaw and Run
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

swsh3-17.flavorText: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

attacks.name: Hard Times Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon-GX in play.

attacks.name: Smash Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

swsh3-18.flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Wildfire
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Vengeful Flame
attacks.text: If your Benched Fire Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 100 more damage.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-22.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Heat Beak
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

swsh3-23.flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

attacks.name: Turbo Drive
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Fire and Fighting type.

swsh3-24.flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Raging Flare
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

swsh3-25.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

swsh3-26.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

swsh3-27.flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

attacks.name: Frozen Heat
attacks.text: You may discard all Water Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 60 more damage.

swsh3-28.flavorText: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

swsh3-29.flavorText: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

attacks.name: Cauterize
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

swsh3-30.flavorText: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

swsh3-31.flavorText: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mach Flight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

abilities.name: Scorching Feathers
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.

swsh3-32.flavorText: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

attacks.name: Radiating Heat
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Centiferno
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you did any damage with this attack, you may attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Reflect
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

swsh3-35.flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

abilities.name: Shuffle Dance
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards with the top card of their deck. (The cards stay face down.)

swsh3-36.flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

attacks.name: Aurora Loop
attacks.text: Put 2 Water Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

swsh3-37.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

swsh3-38.flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

abilities.name: Bright Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

swsh3-39.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

attacks.name: Fossil Search
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Rare Fossil cards and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-40.flavorText: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.

swsh3-41.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

swsh3-42.flavorText: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

swsh3-43.flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Crushing Headbutt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Crushing Headbutt.

swsh3-44.flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

attacks.name: Ice Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

swsh3-45.flavorText: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

attacks.name: Freezing Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

swsh3-46.flavorText: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

abilities.name: Bitter Cold
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

swsh3-47.flavorText: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

swsh3-48.flavorText: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

attacks.name: Frozen Slice
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

swsh3-49.flavorText: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

attacks.name: Deep Sea Swirl
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 8 cards.

swsh3-50.flavorText: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

attacks.name: Regeneration
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

swsh3-51.flavorText: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it.

attacks.name: Poisonous Whip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

swsh3-52.flavorText: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

abilities.name: Primal Law
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon.

swsh3-53.flavorText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

attacks.name: Hard Face
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Cold Breath
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

swsh3-54.flavorText: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

swsh3-55.flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

swsh3-56.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

attacks.name: Dazzle Blast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

swsh3-57.flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

swsh3-58.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flash Impact
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

swsh3-59.flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

attacks.name: Paralyzing Bolt
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Super Zap Cannon
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

swsh3-61.flavorText: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

swsh3-62.flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

attacks.name: Risk Taker
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

swsh3-63.flavorText: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Zing Zap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

swsh3-64.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

attacks.name: Amping Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Amping Up attack does 90 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

swsh3-65.flavorText: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

abilities.name: Biting Whirlpool
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

swsh3-66.flavorText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

swsh3-67.flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

swsh3-68.flavorText: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

attacks.name: X Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3-70.flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

attacks.name: Jaw Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

swsh3-71.flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

swsh3-72.flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

attacks.name: Fortunate Eye
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

swsh3-73.flavorText: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

swsh3-74.flavorText: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Bend
attacks.text: Choose 2 random cards from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck.

swsh3-75.flavorText: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

swsh3-76.flavorText: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

swsh3-77.flavorText: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

swsh3-78.flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

swsh3-79.flavorText: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

attacks.name: Flickering Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Fear the Forest
attacks.text: If Glimwood Tangle is in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

swsh3-80.flavorText: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

abilities.name: Heal Jamming
abilities.text: Your opponent's Benched Pokémon can't be healed.

swsh3-81.flavorText: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

attacks.name: Furtive Drop
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

swsh3-82.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

abilities.name: Tea Break
abilities.text: You must discard a Pokémon that has the Mad Party attack from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

swsh3-83.flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

swsh3-84.flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

swsh3-85.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

swsh3-86.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

attacks.name: Rocket Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-87.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

attacks.name: Bedrock Breaker
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Mountain Swing
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

swsh3-88.flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

attacks.name: Land's Pulse
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 10 more damage.

swsh3-89.flavorText: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

attacks.name: Sand Pulse
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

swsh3-90.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

attacks.name: Desert Geyser
attacks.text: If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it. If you discarded a Stadium in this way, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Labyrinth of Sand
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon can't retreat.

swsh3-91.flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

abilities.name: Resistance Shade
abilities.text: If you have Lunatone in play, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Resistance.

swsh3-92.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

swsh3-93.flavorText: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

swsh3-94.flavorText: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

attacks.name: Drill Run
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Heavy Rock Artillery
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Heavy Rock Artillery.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3-96.flavorText: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

swsh3-97.flavorText: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

attacks.name: Meteor Assault
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Meteor Assault again until it leaves the Active Spot.

swsh3-98.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

attacks.name: Tripping Shot
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

abilities.name: Rapid-Fire Poison
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Stomp Off
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

swsh3-100.flavorText: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

attacks.name: Triple Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.

swsh3-101.flavorText: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

swsh3-102.flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

abilities.name: Spider Net
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Evolution Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

swsh3-103.flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

abilities.name: Dark Asset
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. You can't use more than 1 Dark Asset Ability each turn.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Vortex of Darkness
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Darkness Guard
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached, it takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

swsh3-105.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

swsh3-106.flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Paralyzed.

swsh3-107.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

swsh3-108.flavorText: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

swsh3-109.flavorText: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

abilities.name: Dark Squall
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Darkness Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

swsh3-110.flavorText: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

attacks.name: Assault Gate
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

swsh3-111.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

swsh3-112.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-113.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

attacks.name: Spiky Knuckle
attacks.text: Put 2 Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Drill
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each extra Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon (in addition to this attack's cost). You can't add more than 100 damage in this way.

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Power Accelerator
attacks.text: You may attach a Darkness Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamax Cannon
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon VMAX, this attack does 120 more damage.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Darkness Pokémon in play.

abilities.text: If all of your Pokémon in play are Darkness type, you can have up to 8 Pokémon on your Bench, and you can't put non-Darkness Pokémon into play. (If this Ability stops working, discard Pokémon from your Bench until you have 5.)

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hard Scissors
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Metal Arms
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

swsh3-120.flavorText: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

swsh3-121.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

swsh3-122.flavorText: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

swsh3-123.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 70 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 140 more damage.

swsh3-124.flavorText: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

attacks.name: Call for Backup
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Metal Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-125.flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

attacks.name: Call for Backup
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Metal Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-126.flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

attacks.name: Clockwork
attacks.text: If you don't have Klink and Klang on your Bench, this attack does nothing.

swsh3-127.flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

attacks.name: Trapping Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

abilities.name: Metal Skin
abilities.text: This Pokémon gets +20 HP for each Metal Energy attached to it.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3-129.flavorText: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

attacks.name: Energy Link
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

swsh3-130.flavorText: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

swsh3-131.flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

attacks.name: Vengeful Stomp
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 120 more damage.

abilities.name: Antibacterial Skin
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

swsh3-132.flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

swsh3-133.flavorText: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

swsh3-134.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-135.flavorText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

attacks.name: Feelin' Fine
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

swsh3-136.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

abilities.name: Final Dig
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

swsh3-137.flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

attacks.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

swsh3-138.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

swsh3-139.flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

attacks.name: Energy Loop
attacks.text: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

swsh3-140.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

attacks.name: Drawup Power
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh3-141.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

attacks.name: Captivating Tail
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

swsh3-142.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

attacks.name: Swoop Across
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Sonic Double
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Max Wings
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Max Wings.

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Keen Eye
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.text: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

swsh3-145.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

swsh3-146.flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

attacks.name: Hurricane Blender
attacks.text: Move any amount of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

swsh3-147.flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

swsh3-148.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

attacks.name: Feather Slice
attacks.text: You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.text: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

swsh3-149.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

swsh3-150.flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

swsh3-151.flavorText: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

swsh3-152.flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

attacks.name: Scrape Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Smack and Run
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

swsh3-153.flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

attacks.name: Pluck
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

swsh3-154.flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

swsh3-155.flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

abilities.name: Flying Taxi
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 1 of your Pokémon, except any Corviknight, and all attached cards into your hand.

swsh3-156.flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
